name: times_eq_mul
prelude:
def times : Nat → Nat → Nat
  | 0, _ => 0
  | n + 1, m => times n m + m
statement: theorem times_eq_mul (n m : Nat) : times n m = n * m
proofs:
induction n with
  | zero => simp [times]
  | succ n ih => simp [times, ih, Nat.succ_mul]
  have zero_right (a : Nat) : times a 0 = 0 := by
    induction a with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ a ih => simp [times, ih]
  have succ_right (a b : Nat) : times a (b + 1) = times a b + a := by
    induction a with
    | zero => simp [times]
    | succ a ih => simp [times, ih]; omega
  induction m with
  | zero => simp [zero_right]
  | succ m ih => rw [succ_right, ih, Nat.mul_succ]
strategies: Induction on n, the recursive argument.
Induction on m after proving zero-right and successor-right identities.
